release.notes: STABLE — KantaOke MAIN v1.0.5.9 Build 15.10.5.2. Promoted byte-for-byte from the verified Score Studio Beta vc66: refined black-and-gold Score Studio, independent score sound volume, MP3/WAV/OGG custom score jingle import and preview, editable performance messages per score bracket, lyric preview with non-overlapping 3-2-1 countdown and MIDI-event-driven highlighting, and fresh OTA update checks. Existing scoring algorithm, MIDI timing, queue and song library unchanged. Internal APK version text still says DEV because the identical signed Beta binary was promoted; this Stable channel entry is intentional. Does not include experimental KISC packed-library support from DEV vc67.
